title: Sharks Are Older Than TREES 🦈
description:
Which is older: sharks or trees? Sharks, by a lot. The oldest shark-like scales are about 450 million years old; the first trees appeared around 390 to 385 million years ago. Before that, the tallest plants on land were mosses and liverworts a few centimetres high, while the sea already had early sharks. Then the trees showed up, the dinosaurs came and went, and sharks have made it through all five mass extinctions. (Those oldest scales are debated; the oldest undisputed shark teeth are about 420 million years old, still older than any tree.) What did you guess: sharks or trees?
